response.sql: WITH event_stats AS (SELECT COALESCE(corpeventprx, 'No Event') AS event_type, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anlycount, AVG(inholdpct - instownpct) AS avg_difference FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY COALESCE(corpeventprx, 'No Event')), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_difference) AS overall_average_diff FROM event_stats) SELECT event_stats.event_type, event_stats.avg_anlycount, event_stats.avg_difference, event_stats.avg_difference - overall_avg.overall_average_diff AS difference_from_overall FROM event_stats CROSS JOIN overall_avg WHERE overall_avg.overall_average_diff IS NOT NULL ORDER BY event_stats.event_type
